race.description: Gold Coast Chinatown Year Of The Horse Hcp (C1)
race.comment: A real lottery. MYTHOLOGY (9) raced handy and only felt the pinch in the final stages when resuming over 1200m at Doomben last start. Scored last prep at Eagle Farm at her only try over 1400m. Fitter and with the blinkers back on looks set for a big performance. BUCKEYE (2) has started favourite but been a little disappointing in his two runs this prep, the latest over 1350m at Ipswich when he didn't finish the race off. Drops 4.5kgs after the claim and is fitter now so give him one more chance. BRUTAL MISS (16) went very well first-up at Grafton then struggled on a heavy deck at Ballina most recently. Probably looking for 1400m now and on a drier track comes right into calculations. CHATTERLEY (3) didn't do a great deal first-up over 1200m at Eagle Farm but will be far more effective out to this distance. AUTUMNGIRL (10) as brave in defeat at Doomben last start. Looks beautifully placed in this easier race after Youngberry's claim.
